DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia

The clinical picture of a 26-year-old male with a 3-month history of paranoid delusions (mind control, NSA surveillance), depressive symptoms, functional decline (job loss), and bizarre behavior (inventing a device), in the absence of substance use, medical illness, or mania, is diagnostic of Schizophrenia.
